description: Sends the same conversation (or one prompt) to 2 to 5 chat model ids at once through POST /v1/chat/completions and returns every answer side by side with its token usage, cost and time, plus the total. For a second opinion from another model, or to pick the model that answers a kind of question best. Completions are capped at max_tokens each (default 1024). Each model is billed to the key in the MCP request's Authorization header; a model that fails is reported and not charged.

image_urls.description: Image URLs attached to the last user message, for the chat models that take images (input_modalities in list_models). A file generate made works.

max_tokens.description: Cap on completion tokens per model. Default 1024.

models.description: 2 to 5 chat model ids from list_models, asked at the same time.

prompt.description: One user message, in place of messages.

system.description: Instructions placed ahead of the conversation as a system message.

name: compare
title: Ask several models the same thing
